## TOML Language Server
 - Bundled TextMate grammar (`source.toml`): `.toml` files are coloured the moment they open, no server needed
 - Completion, hover, diagnostics, document symbols and formatting from Taplo
 - Works with Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, config.toml and every other TOML file
 - Installs the official static `taplo` release (LSP build) inside the rootfs
 - Capabilities: completion, hover, diagnostics, symbols, folding, links, rename, semantic tokens, formatting
